name.en: Hettich SAH 130 cabinet hanger, mounting rail type B
name.de: Hettich Schrankaufhänger SAH 130, Montageschiene Typ B

articles.note: mounting rail type L, 130 mm (visible end sides)

source: Hettich SAH 130 product page and assembly instruction: two Ø10 × 11.5 press-in holes on the inside of each side, row 23.7 below the top edge, 20.5 and 52.5 in front of the back's front face; back front face ≥ 16 from the side's rear edge; 35 kg per hanger; rail ~28 high, 6.5 off the wall. The side notch for the rail (29 high × 18 deep) is read from an unlabelled isometric — CHECK before machining. See docs/hardware-research/hanging-flaps.json.
